en: A vintage colorized postcard showing a wide river or canal lined with traditional Dutch houses on the right and a large windmill behind them. A sailing boat with a single large sail moves along the water toward the background town. The scene is calm and rural, with low buildings and flat landscape along the banks. Printed captions in red and black appear at the bottom of the card.
